# SLA Monitoring Dashboard – Database Cluster Metrics

**Report Period:** 2026-05-12 18:05 IST – 2026-05-12 21:30 IST  
**Generated:** 2026-05-12 21:45 IST  
**Source:** SLA Monitoring Dashboard (Cluster: prod-db-east-1)  
**Incident Reference:** INC-2026-0512-014 (resolved 20:47 IST)

---

## 1. Executive Summary

The database cluster experienced a second degradation window during the evening peak between 18:10 and 19:55 IST. This was a recurrence of the afternoon saturation event on db-node-02, triggered by a batch job that was not properly throttled after the earlier pool resize. Primary metrics returned to normal operating ranges by 20:15 IST. No SLA breach was recorded; the 99.9% monthly availability target remains intact.

Full resolution confirmed at 20:47 IST after the problematic batch process was killed and its queue drained. Monitoring continued through 21:30 IST to verify stability.

---
